components.explanation: Ten thin scenes; each level is one Node3D with level.gd and a level_id.
levels.gd: the six ASCII maps, hints and legends; level.gd builds them, places the backdrop and runs the level.
fighter.gd: one CharacterBody3D for the player and every bot: movement, jumps, ledges, walls, attacks, hits and deaths.
weapon.gd: the axe on the floor, in the hand, thrown and dropped; the hammer is spawned by fighter.gd.
ai.gd: the bots' brain (and the playtest autopilot); nav.gd: the grid links it paths over.
level.gd scoring, gate, checkpoints, death and respawn; game_state.gd campaign, input map and save.
hud.gd: HP, score, gate, hammer, boss bar, hints, K.O., pause, options and Level Clear; options_panel.gd.
main_menu.gd, character_select.gd, stage.gd (the select stage), instructions.gd and credits.gd.
audio.gd autoload: named sounds, loops and music; bus layout.
kit.gd autoload: characters, props, materials and hit effects.
_tools: asset converter, bone maps, import patch, animation baker, level drafting aid, icon, screenshots and the playtest.
project.godot (3 autoloads, Forward+, Jolt), export presets and README.
Y Bot, Amy and Sophie with their clips, the yard pack, props, textures, fonts, UI images and synthesized audio, with import settings.

script = ExtResource("1")
level_id = 1

# Hit window
	var hit: Array = a["hit"]
	if t >= hit[0] and t <= hit[1]:
		_check_hits()
	# WeaponThrow at ThrowTiming
	if attack_id == "throw" and not _released_axe and t >= a["release"]:
		_released_axe = true
		throw_weapon()
	# Combos: attack again inside the window chains the next part (TransitionIndexer + ATTACK)
	if a.has("combo") and _attack_buffer > 0.0 and t >= hit[0]:
		_queued_attack = a["combo"]
		_attack_buffer = 0.0
	if _queued_attack != "" and t >= a["combo_at"]:
		_start_attack(_queued_attack)

func throw_weapon() -> void:
	if holding == null:
		return
	var w := holding
	holding = null
	stats["throws"] += 1
	w.throw(self, global_position + Vector3(facing * 0.6, 1.25, 0), facing)

func _takedown_victim() -> Fighter:
	for other in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("fighters"):
		var f: Fighter = other
		if f == self or f.team == team or f.state == S.DEAD or f.kind == "sophie":
			continue
		var d := f.global_position - global_position
		# behind an enemy that has not noticed you, both on the same floor
		if d.x * facing > 0.2 and d.x * facing < 1.3 and absf(d.y) < 0.3 and f.facing == facing \
				and not f.aware and f.is_on_floor() and f.state in [S.IDLE, S.WALK]:
			return f
	return null

code_result_pairs.observation: Level 1 loads fully built: yard backdrop, blocks and containers, lights, HUD, banner.
The block, lights, ledge and first bot sit where the level 1 map puts them.
D held; Shift toggles walk and run; Space jumps onto the block.
Jab, cross, uppercut, block and hammer from the key showcase.
Jab, cross and kick chain on the bots at the foot of the level 2 shaft.
The ledge on the level 1 block is grabbed and climbed.
Wall slide, wall jump and the grab at the top of the level 2 shaft.
The axe is picked up and thrown into a bot.
The level 4 guard bot stays unaware as the player walks up behind it.
The takedown plays on the unaware bot.
The plate arms, fires and kills; the player respawns at the checkpoint.
A fall into the pit is a K.O.; the player respawns at the start.
After Options in the pause menu, Esc shows the pause panel without pausing the tree.
Green is chosen with the arrows; Enter presses Back and the choice is not saved.
